notes:
- Account background: regional last-mile logistics platform; heavy real-time chat for driver support + reranking for route suggestions. Sensitive PII in transcripts; must comply with SOC2 and company data residency rules.
- POC results: sustained 42,000 tokens/sec during business-hour simulated traffic on 6x A100-80GB equivalent. Token distribution: 60% short chat turns (~30 tokens), 40% medium prompts (~150 tokens).
- Redwood proposal (initial): guarantee min 35k tokens/sec sustained for 30-day rolling window on Dedicated pool (8x A100 equiv reserved), concurrency cap 300 simultaneous streams, burst allowance up to 120k tokens/sec for 120 seconds per incident, aggregate burst budget 1M tokens/month before overage. Pricing: base reserved fee + burst usage priced at $0.12 / 1k tokens beyond budget.
- Customer pushback / asks: wants longer bursts (up to 10 minutes) during surge events and lower overage rates; also requests per-route concurrency caps (higher concurrency for reranking route, lower for chat). Wants a per-route SLA: 95th-percentile < 150ms per token for chat, < 100ms for reranking.
- Technical constraints noted: customer network egress through single VPC endpoint, desire for IPV6 internal addressing, and strict egress audit logs. They require KMS integration for model caches and KV store keys.
- Capacity planning discussion: customer forecast expects seasonal peaks (Q3) with ~2.5x baseline traffic. Suggested reservation: start with 8x A100 equiv, scale to 12x with canary autoscale based on queue depth. Customer asked for guaranteed provisioning timeline (15 minute cold-start max for burst scale-up) — Redwood asked to keep burst scaling bounded to pre-warmed pool sizes.
- SLA negotiation items to close: exact min tokens/sec metric definition (aggregate vs per-tenant), measurement window, allowable maintenance windows, credits formula for missed SLO, and billing for burst overdraft. Customer legal requests: indemnity up to net fees and clause for performance credits tied to measured throughput.
- Quotes / paraphrase: "We need predictable throughput during 08-10 and 17-19 — last-mile delays cost us $X/min." — Head of Ops.
- Internal AE notes: emphasize Optimize advisory to reduce sustained tokens via caching/prefix reuse; propose A/B of per-route batching profiles. SE to provide breakdown mapping tokens/sec guarantees to GPU counts and expected p95 latency under modeled traffic.
- Decisions pending: final burst duration, overage rate, per-route concurrency enforcement, and approval from SecOps on KMS design.
- Stubs/links: see drive pricing deck (linked_drive_docs), POC logs uploaded to bucket (internal link in SE notes), Fireflies call IDs above.
negotiation_points: Minimum guaranteed throughput: customer requested 35k tokens/sec sustained (Redwood POC shows 42k).
Concurrency caps: propose 300 concurrent streams; customer requests per-route caps: chat 200, rerank 500.
Burst policy: propose 120k tokens/sec for 120s, monthly burst budget 1M tokens; customer requests 10m bursts and lower overage rate.
Reserved GPU planning: map 8x A100-80GB equiv to 35k sustained, recommend 12x for safe headroom for Q3 peak.
Latency SLOs: target p95 token latency <150ms chat, <100ms rerank; measurement window 30d rolling.
SLA credits/penalties: define credit curve for % below guaranteed tokens/sec; legal wants clear indemnity/credit caps.
